stock.description: Jolimark Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of various electronic devices, notably printers, across the People's Republic of China. Under its proprietary Jolimark brand, the firm offers a diverse array of products including rolling and flatbed dot matrix printers, passbook printers, thermal and dot matrix point-of-sale (POS) systems, POS terminals, compact printers, tax-controlled electronic cash registers (ECRs), and DLP projectors, alongside other electronic goods. Furthermore, Jolimark provides design, manufacturing, and sales services for business and tax control equipment, as well as other electronic items, on an EMS/ODM/OEM (Electronic Manufacturing Services/Original Design Manufacturer/Original Equipment Manufacturer) basis. The company also serves as a distributor for EPSON-branded Serial Impact Dot Matrix (SIDM) printers. Its operations extend to research and development activities focusing on inkjet print head technology and the Internet of Things (IoT), alongside offering import and export services for the electronics sector. Additionally, Jolimark functions as a logistics agent. Established in 1986, Jolimark Holdings Limited is based in Jiangmen, People's Republic of China, and operates as a subsidiary of Kytronics Holdings Limited.
